name: myosin light chain 4
relevance: Atrial myosin light chain helps maintain atrial contraction and structure. Selected MYL4 variants cause atrial myopathy with early-onset atrial fibrillation or conduction disease. Dominant and recessive disease mechanisms have been described.
consideration: Distinguish selected dominant missense variants from biallelic loss-of-function disease. Confirm zygosity, phase, and phenotype; one recessive allele does not establish a diagnosis.
caution: AF extension beyond the source PDF. Variant-specific familial evidence is not a blanket pathogenicity rule for all MYL4 variants.
